name: dominoes27
description: All Fives dominoes in the browser — zero dependencies, no build step. AI opponents with personalities & trash talk, 4-language i18n (EN/ES/AR/ZH), achievements, PWA. Pure HTML/CSS/JS.

paragraphs: A feature-rich, zero-dependency browser domino game. Pure HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no server, no frameworks.
features: Gameplay — Full All Fives rules with spinner mechanics, 1–3 AI opponents or 2v2 teams, 3 difficulty levels, 5 AI personality types, minimax hint system, drag-and-drop tile placement, board pinch-zoom/pan, and auto-play…

AI — Each opponent gets a random generation (Gen Z, Millennial, Gen X, Boomer) that determines how they trash-talk. 300+ culturally authentic phrases across 4 languages. Personalities affect play style: Aggressive,…

Visuals — 3D tiles with 6 skins (Classic, Marble, Wood, Neon, Gold, Midnight), felt grain texture with table-lamp lighting, animated dealing with cinematic player intros, tile fly-in animations with landing shockwaves,…

i18n — English, Spanish, Arabic (full RTL), Chinese. Auto-detects browser language. Language picker on first visit. Culturally appropriate AI names, cities, and dialogue per language. Rules and tutorial fully translated.
Progression — XP leveling, 17 achievements, lifetime stats, head-to-head records vs each AI, daily first-game bonus.

whatItDoes.text: A feature-rich, zero-dependency browser domino game. Pure HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no server, no frameworks.
